prompt_too_long.root_cause: Batch size too large - 850 PDFs sent to single arbiter phase
prompt_too_long.fix: Reduce batch size to 10-20 PDFs per orchestration batch

gemini_access_denied.fix: Use Thompson Sampling to exclude failing models, prefer Opus/Sonnet/Haiku

phase_2.name: Full processing
phase_2.parallelization: Use fleet workers (aio-01, server-01, server-02, server-03)

haiku.note: Only use for lightweight probing, not extraction

orchestrator_learning.lesson_1: Always validate batch size doesn't exceed model context limits
orchestrator_learning.lesson_2: Use Thompson Sampling to avoid models with access issues
orchestrator_learning.lesson_3: Test with small batch before scaling to full dataset
orchestrator_learning.lesson_4: Monitor token usage to detect prompt length issues early
orchestrator_learning.lesson_5: Local models (codestral, deepseek-r1) can substitute for cloud models with access issues
